customer: Hello, I'm moving out of Dunmore for a new job and I'm planning to sell my midsize SUV before I go. I already have an online offer, but I'm a little nervous it could drop at the appraisal. Could you tell me what might change it?
agent: Congratulations on the new job! As explained in our article "What can change your offer at the appraisal," the appraisal confirms your offer unless we find something your online answers didn't mention, such as undisclosed damage or warning lights, a missing key or remote ($150 off for each missing key), aftermarket parts that have to be removed or replaced, or mileage more than 300 miles above what you entered. If anything changes, the specialist will show you the reason before you decide, and you can always say no and keep your SUV. If your SUV has any modifications, our article "Cars with aftermarket modifications" has more details.
